title: From Data Alignment to Parameter Generation: Few-Shot Cross-City Traffic Prediction with Conditional Diffusion
abstract: arXiv:2611.25592v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate mobile traffic forecasting is crucial for network service management, supporting proactive capacity provisioning, congestion mitigation, and energy-efficient operation. However, many cities and regions are data-scarce (e.g., newly deployed or poorly instrumented areas), thus making traffic prediction a few-shot learning problem and limiting the practicality of standard data-driven models. Existing cross-city solutions primarily rely on data-space alignment to match traffic distributions between data-rich and data-scarce cities, but such alignment is often brittle under real-world distribution shifts, measurement noise, and city-specific bias. To address these limitations, we propose a Conditional Diffusion-based Parameter Generation (CDPG) framework. Instead of aligning raw data, CDPG learns the conditional distribution of high-performing predictor parameters for source cities and directly generates node-specific model parameter

translated_title: 从数据对齐到参数生成：基于条件扩散的少样本跨城市流量预测
translated_abstract: 准确的移动流量预测对于网络服务管理至关重要，可支持主动的容量规划、拥塞缓解和节能运行。然而，许多城市和地区数据稀缺（例如新部署或监测设备不完善的区域），这使得流量预测成为一个少样本学习问题，并限制了标准数据驱动模型的实用性。现有的跨城市解决方案主要依赖数据空间对齐来匹配数据丰富城市与数据稀缺城市之间的流量分布，但这种对齐方式在真实世界的分布偏移、测量噪声和城市特有偏差下往往十分脆弱。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于条件扩散的参数生成（CDPG）框架。CDPG不再对齐原始数据，而是学习源城市高性能预测器参数的条件分布，并直接生成节点特定的模型参数
tldr: 该论文提出了基于条件扩散的参数生成框架（CDPG），通过学习源城市高性能预测器参数的条件分布来直接生成目标城市各节点的模型参数，从而突破了传统数据对齐方法在少样本跨城市流量预测中易受分布偏移、测量噪声和城市特有偏差影响的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Conditional Diffusion-based Parameter Generation (CDPG) framework that learns the conditional distribution of high-performing predictor parameters from source cities and directly generates node-specific model parameters, overcoming the brittleness of traditional data-alignment approaches under distribution shifts, measurement noise, and city-specific bias in few-shot cross-city traffic prediction.
